Минулого літа ми їздили до Львова, гуляли старими вуличками та їли гарячі сирники.
Нагадай мені в четвер зателефонувати бабусі й забрати з пошти посилку від друга.
Вчера вечером мы долго гуляли по набережной и спорили о новых фильмах.
Если завтра будет дождь, я останусь дома, сварю борщ и почитаю интересную книгу.
Пожалуйста, перешли мне счёт за электричество до пятницы, чтобы я успел всё оплатить.
The weather changed so quickly that we had to wait under the old bridge for the rain to pass.
I usually start my morning with a short walk, a strong coffee and a quick look at my calendar.

Location tags Tag conversations with a coarse place Nytka reads a coarse location when a capture session starts and, once your server has a conversation for it, adds the name of a saved place or a city-level label as a tag. Your exact coordinates never leave the phone. Without location Nytka cannot tag conversations. Switch on again to be asked Without location Nytka cannot tag conversations. Nudges Notify me of nudges Your server tells Nytka when a commitment is due within a day, when your evening recap is ready, when an insight unlocks and when a day differs from your usual. Nytka checks every 15 minutes. The lock screen shows no text. Without notifications Nytka cannot show a nudge. Switch on again to be asked Without notifications Nytka cannot show a nudge. People settings Recording people without their consent is illegal in some places. Grouping voices keeps a voice model of each person you name; turn it on only where you may. Nytka names a voice itself when it hears a name with at least people.autoApplyConfidence (0.5 to 1). Each one shows under Named for you in the review inbox, with Undo. Voice models in Nytka Nytka keeps voice groups and a voiceprint for each person you named, on your server. This deletes all of them. It does not touch the voice models the transcription service keeps; to remove one of those, delete the person and choose to remove the voice model. Delete all voice groups and voiceprints Delete all voice groups and voiceprints? Your server deletes every voice group, every voiceprint of a named person and every voice match waiting in the review inbox. People, names and lines stay, but Nytka no longer recognizes anyone by voice until you turn voice matching on and name voices again. This cannot be undone. Phone microphone Record with this phone\'s microphone Records everyone near the phone, for as long as this is on, with an ongoing notification. Off by default; Nytka never turns it on by itself, and it is off again after a restart. Its audio goes to your server apart from the pendant\'s and never joins a pendant conversation. Mute pauses it too. This phone has no Opus encoder, so it cannot record in the format your server takes. Nytka needs the microphone and notification permissions for this. Android no longer asks for these permissions. Allow the microphone and notifications in the app\'s settings.
